Freeze/blur motion
Set camera shutter speed to 1/30
of a second to get a blur shot
of your subject moving.
To get a freeze shot of a
moving subject you may have to
set the shutter speed up to 1/1000
of a second if say your subject is
a car driving
for blur you must remain as
still as possible because the
shutter is open longer than
normal
